name: kedrzu-skills
description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills shared across projects

plugins.name: design-doc
plugins.description: Think a feature through with the user before building it, and leave behind a design folder: a readable story over a record of the decisions in force and what each rejected, with its history archived beside it

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Plan, build, verify and land code changes through one pipeline — /dev:fix, /dev:task, /dev:feature, /dev:build and /dev:deliver — with approval gates, sequential implementers, a subtractive prune pass and stacked PRs. On request, /dev:review fixes what nobody would argue with and posts the rest that survived a refutation pass as inline PR findings, /dev:fix-pr-comments acts on the unresolved PR threads and asks in chat where a fix needs a choice, /dev:review-and-fix loops the two until review calls the branch finished, and /dev:explain-pr explains a PR or a whole stacked chain in plain language. Project-specific checks and git flow come from the project's own verify and git-workflow skills, which /dev:setup and /git:setup write

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git operations agents get wrong in ways that silently lose work — resolving merge, rebase and cherry-pick conflicts by both sides' intent, stashing safely when several worktrees or parallel agents share one clone, a hook that blocks unnamed stashes, unref'd pops, plain force-pushes and, where a project opts in, pushes to its protected branches, and /git:setup, which writes the project's git-workflow skill and .claude/git.json

plugins.name: gdrive-mcp
plugins.description: Multi-account Google Drive for agents: browse, read Docs as Markdown, download, upload, edit and trash files — each permission switched per project, several Google Cloud apps at once, never deletes permanently

plugins.name: gmail-mcp
plugins.description: Multi-account Gmail for agents: search, read as Markdown, drafts with attachments, label rules — configured per project, several Google Cloud apps at once, never sends

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Mechanical safety guards for agents: hooks that refuse a dangerous command and tell the agent what to do instead. First guard: no inline node/bun eval (-e, -p), which turns any library that forks with execArgv into a fork bomb

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Hand the work to a fresh agent: a summary of the session that points at existing artifacts, then a new Paseo agent (or a background claude) started with it

plugins.name: naming
plugins.description: Find a name for a product, app or site over several rounds: candidates in chosen directions, domain checks, conflict checks, and a record in the repo so no feedback has to be repeated

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright MCP browser automation, run on bun instead of npx — the one browser every skill in this marketplace depends on

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Retrospective on how agents worked in a project: root cause from Claude Code and Codex transcripts and PR reviews, verdicts on the previous retro, and proposed changes to the environment

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Collect API keys and tokens through a masked dialog the agent cannot read, and hand them to scripts without exposing them — no secret ever pasted into the chat

plugins.name: shopping-research
plugins.description: Find the best product to buy against your criteria: an accepted spec first, then a wide longlist, parallel deep dives and a ranking with the best obtainable price and a link to buy every pick

plugins.name: skill-improve
plugins.description: Revise an existing skill so the agent behaves as intended, without the skill swelling — evidence from real transcripts first, knowledge grows freely, procedure asks

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: One-way Telegram notifications: let the agent reach your phone when you are away from the terminal

plugins.name: web-search
plugins.description: Protocol for effective web research: engine selection, query hygiene, graded negative verdicts and primary-source verification

plugins.name: wait-what
plugins.description: /wait-what: the last message did not land, so the agent pitches it again plainly, with context

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Read WhatsApp chats and attachments from the macOS desktop app's local database — list chats, read or search messages, find and copy files. Read-only
